_meta.what: Red Bull RB22 / Red Bull Ford DM01 physical parameters derived from real qualifying telemetry (Silverstone 2026) by inverse vehicle dynamics, for PURPLE's physics lap simulator. Speeds in the simulator must come from these parameters; telemetry is used only to measure what is not public and for held-out checks.
_meta.telemetry_dir: external copy of concept/data/telemetry (22 qualifying laps, telemetry commit bae7a51)
_meta.units: SI (m, kg, s, W expressed as kW where the key says kw, J as MJ where the key says mj)

kinds.assumption: not observable from these data; value stated, varied in the sensitivity runs where it matters

physical_car.label: Red Bull RB22 / Red Bull Ford DM01, Silverstone 2026 qualifying: derived from telemetry (inverse vehicle dynamics), see docs/concept/REDBULL-DERIVED.md

mass_kg.basis: C4.1 726 kg + Nominal Tyre Mass 44 kg (implied by the reported 768 kg race minimum) + Red Bull +9.5 kg reported over the minimum (RacingNews365, April 2026); fuel separate

wheelbase_m.basis: C2.3.3 maximum 3.400 m (RB22 assumed at the maximum)

cog_height_m.basis: 0.28 m above the ground (plank and ride height included, as in the current PhysicalCar contract); typical value, not observable from speed/position telemetry. Used only for longitudinal load transfer in the traction limit

session.basis: qualifying: C4.1 minimum 726 kg + Nominal Tyre Mass, Silverstone Q recharge 6.5 MJ

aero.floor_stalled.basis: false: the measured lateral and braking performance shows no sign of a stalled floor; not observable directly

aero.stall_margin_mm / ride_height_mm.basis: null: ride height is not in the public feed

weight_dist_front.basis: C4.2: front >= 0.44, rear >= 0.54 of the minimum mass; 0.45 assumed

aero.corner.CLA_total.basis: cornering: a_y = μ_y(g + ½ρClA v²/m) at grip-limited corner minima

aero.corner.balance_front.basis: front share 0.43 (not separable: speed + x/y carry no axle information)

aero.corner.CDA_m2.basis: power balance with the MGU-K reaching its 350 kW cap on the best corner exits and ICE = η_th × regulated fuel flow

aero.straight.CDA_m2.basis: CdA_c − ΔCdA, ΔCdA from the acceleration step at Straight Mode activation over all laps (zones A2-A4 where both windows stay below 1.5 g lateral: in practice A3, plus one A4)

aero.straight.CLA.basis: not measured (no cornering in Straight Mode); set equal to Corner Mode, which is an upper bound

pu.ice_kw.basis: η_th 0.475 ± 0.025 × 833.3 kW fuel energy flow (C5.2.3) at >= 10 500 rpm

pu.es_deploy_mj_per_lap.basis: ∫K_DC dt over full-throttle phases where K_DC > 0

pu.es_harvest_mj_per_lap.basis: Silverstone qualifying recharge limit 6.5 MJ/lap (FIA PU information)

tyres.mu_x.basis: fit of the speed-vs-distance trace in each brake zone (friction circle)

tyres.load_sens.basis: 0: μ values are effective values at the loads seen on this lap

tyres.radius_m.basis: 18 in rim (C10.7.2) + ~707 mm 2026 tyre (press, unverified), loaded rolling radius

drivetrain_eff.basis: 0.95; degenerate with η_th for the ICE term

gearing.rev_limit_note: highest rpm seen on the Red Bull laps (observed, not the regulation limit)
gearing.note: gear 1 is not used on a flying lap; 8 forward gears seen

pu_curve.ice_basis: η_th × fuel energy flow limit (C5.2.3: 3000 MJ/h at >= 10 500 rpm; 0.27·N + 165 MJ/h below)

braking_joint_fit.note: braking alone cannot separate μ_x·ClA from CdA: the joint fit runs to the edge of its CdA grid (2.4 m²). Drag is 10-20 % of the deceleration, inside the noise of the 3.7 Hz trace. Shown as a check only
